evals.prompt: I need a tool my agent can use to run analytics queries against our read replica.
evals.expected_output: A Pydantic v2 schema named with a verb_noun pattern, constrained to read-only SQL, with a bounded timeout and a structured result model.
expectations: The tool name follows the verb_noun pattern, for example run_sql
The sql parameter carries a pattern constraint restricting it to SELECT or WITH
A timeout parameter is bounded with an upper limit
The docstring contains a when-to-use section, a do-not-use section, and a description of the return value
A separate Pydantic result model is defined rather than returning a raw dict or string

evals.prompt:
Tighten this up for me:

class Search(BaseModel):
    query: str
    filters: dict
    opts: dict
evals.expected_output: A rewritten schema that renames the tool, replaces both dict parameters with typed constrained fields, and adds a result model.
expectations: The tool is renamed to a verb_noun form such as search_documents
The query parameter gains a length constraint
Neither unconstrained dict parameter survives in the rewritten schema
Pagination or result limits are expressed as bounded integers
The response explains why unconstrained dict parameters are a problem for tool selection

evals.prompt: Design a tool that lets the agent send a customer refund.
evals.expected_output: A schema with constrained amount and currency fields, an idempotency key, and an explicit non-idempotent warning in the docstring.
expectations: The amount parameter is bounded with a minimum and maximum
The currency parameter uses an enum or Literal rather than a free string
An idempotency key parameter is included
The docstring explicitly flags the tool as having irreversible side effects
The schema has five or fewer parameters, or the response justifies a split
